verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Codex Plugins as a plugin system that runs inside OpenAI's ChatGPT and Codex surfaces, with a universal hosted directory and an OpenAI submission and review portal. Nothing documents deploying or running the plugin platform itself on user infrastructure. Local and repo marketplaces, `codex plugin marketplace add`, and portable skill folders are adjacent distribution and authoring features, so they earn no credit toward self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
